title: Damaged-Unit Value for Prompt Reports by Tailwise Autoship Customers
content:
**Loyalty team note - returnless damage credits on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders.**

The damaged-unit value on a returnless damage credit depends on the report date and on the customer's Tailwise Autoship shipments. The report date is the requested date of the damage report being settled; the shipments are the shipment charge entries on any of the customer's Tailwise Autoship subscriptions dated fewer than 12 whole months before today.

**Rule.** Where the report date is no more than 3 calendar days after the order's completed date and 6 or more Autoship shipments were charged to the customer in the last 12 months, each damaged unit is valued at the unit list price on the line charge. Where the report date is no more than 3 days after the completed date and at least one but fewer than 6 such shipments were charged, it is valued at the price paid per unit plus half of the coupon and certificate allocated per unit charged, rounded half up to the cent. In every other case this note sets no other value.

### Combinations

| Report date after completion | Autoship shipments in 12 months | Damaged-unit value |
|---|---|---|
| 0 to 3 days | 6 or more | Unit list price |
| 0 to 3 days | 1 to 5 | Price paid per unit plus half the allocated coupon and certificate per unit, rounded half up |
| 0 to 3 days | None | No value set by this note |
| 4 days or more | any | No value set by this note |

### Terms

- **Days after completion** - calendar days from the completed date to the report date; a report on day 3 is within 3 days, a report on day 4 is not.
- **Price paid per unit** - the amount billed on the order's line charges divided by the units charged on them, rounded half up to the cent.
- **Unit list price** - the unit price on the order's line charge (the highest of them where the order carries several).
- **Allocated coupon and certificate per unit charged** - the coupon and certificate amounts on the order's line charges, added together and divided by the units charged.

**Example (hypothetical).** A line of 4 units at $12.00 carries a $4.00 coupon and was billed $44.00; price paid per unit $11.00. A report on day 2 by a customer with 3 Autoship shipments in 12 months values each damaged unit at $11.00 plus half of $1.00, that is $11.50; with 7 shipments, $12.00.
